title: Why Youtube is better than Instagram for business
description: Why Youtube is better than Instagram for business
transcript: There's plenty of data and stats that go out there and show why YouTube is the best, but the one that I reference here is what's known as the half life of your content. The half life is how long on average does it take for the average person to have their post receive 50% of the engagement it's ever gonna get. So what was really interesting was somewhere like Instagram, you could have a half life of 19 hours. On YouTube, it is about nine days long. So nine days and you're getting half of the engagement that you're gonna get on that post.
